rationale: CO-29 timely filing on a commercial (CI) remit. The 277CA shows the claim accepted for adjudication on 2025-01-27, eight days after the 2025-01-19 DOS — an acceptance report, the strongest proof of timely receipt. Proof of accepted submission inside the window routes to appeal disputing the receipt date, not a write-off. N211 bars appeal only on Medicare FFS; this is commercial.

root_cause.explanation: Both lines denied CO-29 as if received on the 2025-10-15 transmission, but the clearinghouse 277CA accepted the same claim (TRC75364521) for adjudication on 2025-01-27, 8 days after the 2025-01-19 DOS.

next_action.detail: Appeal to Liberty Bell disputing the receipt date. Attach the 277CA acceptance (A2 / status 20, received 2025-01-27, claim TRC75364521, $138.62) proving receipt 8 days post-DOS. Do not resubmit; do not bill the patient.
